rows.item_description: Concerning career and technical education in sixth grade. (Hearing is on the Proposed Substitute.) (Remote Testimony Available).

Improving school safety by extending penalties for interference by, or intimidation by threat of, force or violence at schools and extracurricular activities and requiring schools to notify the public of such penalties. (Remote Testimony Available).
Extending special education services to students with disabilities until the end of the school year in which the student turns 22. (Remote Testimony Available).
Providing adequate and predictable student transportation.
Concerning school district materials, supplies, and operating costs.
Updating emergency response systems in public schools including panic or alert buttons.
Supporting remote testing options for students enrolled in online school programs.
